intro.en: The Dwarf Spirit Festival is the most important festival of the Saisiyat people. It is held around the tenth lunar month, and the Saisiyat call

intro.py: Zhè jìdiǎn wèi “Bāsī dáài”. Xiāngchuán zài hěnjiǔyǐqián, yǒu yìqún jūzhù zài shānlǐ de ǎirén, shēngāo zhǐyǒu

intro.py: Fāxiàn zú lǐ xǔduō fùnǚ dōu huáiyùn le. Yīncǐ, Sàixiàrén yuèláiyuè yuànhèn ǎi rén. Zhídào yǒu yìnián de jìdiǎn,

intro.en: So they secretly lay in ambush on the dwarfs' way home and set a trap, making the dwarfs fall one by one into a deep chasm
